say:0:1110829001:0.source_cn: 阿塔兰忒，咸水镇在哪个方向？

say:1:1110829002:0.text: We have to go east from here, through a canyon and over a wooden bridge.
say:1:1110829002:0.source_cn: 从这里一路往东，经过一座峡谷和木桥才能到。

say:2:1110829003:0.text: Be careful not to get blown away by the sandstorms! *Laughs*
